bagPolicy.summary: Evening concerts at Caesars Superdome allow only clear bags up to 12" x 12" x 6" or small clutches up to 4.5" x 6.5".
allowed: Clear vinyl bags up to 12" wide x 12" high x 6" deep
One gallon-size clear Ziploc bag (instead of a clear bag)
Small clutch purses up to 4.5" x 6.5"
prohibited: Video cameras and cameras with lenses over 6"
bagPolicy.note: Policy as posted on the Caesars Superdome event page for ESSENCE Festival of Culture 2026 (July 3 to 5, 2026). It covers the Superdome evening concerts only; daytime events at the Convention Center are separate.

parking.note: Ample parking is available at the Convention Center for a daily fee, but overnight parking is prohibited. ADA parking is available, and specific needs can be addressed via email.

rideshare.note: At the New Orleans Convention Center, use the designated Taxi/Rideshare Zone off S. Peters Street. Follow the Pedestrian Crossing across Calliope Street, which connects the zone with Lobby G.

concessions.note: The venue features Dutch’s Corner, an in-house convenience store located next to the UPS Store in Lobby E. It offers a variety of snacks and beverages for attendees.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The New Orleans Convention Center has ample ADA parking, straight ahead after turning onto S. Peters Street. Email parking@mccno.com if you have specific needs.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Essence Festival of Culture's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Essence Festival of Culture. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: At the New Orleans Convention Center, enter at the main entrance on the corner of Julia Street and Convention Center Boulevard, or at the Transportation Center entrance at Lobby G.
